describe.description: The creature is shown in right-facing side profile standing on a small patch of bare dirt with sparse pebbles and tufts of moss. It has a stout, low-slung body with a pale pink, wrinkled and transversely ringed underbelly and sides, and a broad back and long thick tail covered dorsally in overlapping glossy brown scales. The head at the front right is rounded, pale pink and smooth with large prominent eyes, a blunt snout with small nostrils, and a faint smile, with six feathery pink external gills protruding from behind the head. It stands on four short thick limbs with clawed feet, and the tail tapers to a point at the left rear.

describe.description: A low-slung quadrupedal creature shown in right-facing side view with a pale pink, broad and flat axolotl-like head and soft wrinkled body combined with a complete covering of large overlapping brown scales over its back and tail. The head has large dark eyes, a wide upturned mouth, and pink stalked feathery gills behind it. The pale pink underbody is transversely wrinkled and supported by four short thick legs with splayed clawed toes. A long tapering tail extends to the left, scaled on top and ringed pale skin below.
